name: Amagi Kikou
source:
A familiar demon served by the head of the Amagi family, she fights using the demon sword "Beni Tsuki". She's currently acting as Touya's little sister, not as a famiiliar. Recently, she seems to be patrolling night after night to keep the neighborhood safe.
